verdict.rationale: Activepieces is an automation platform, not an agent, so an official MCP server applies. Its docs describe a built-in MCP server that lets Claude, Cursor, Codex or any MCP client build flows, manage tables and test automations, and a probe confirms the MCP docs page exists; an embeddable MCP option for embedded users adds depth. The agent-tools page on connecting to external MCP servers is client-side and was not credited. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of connecting an agent to the MCP server.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: Activepieces includes a built-in MCP server that lets AI assistants build flows, manage tables, test automations, and more — all through natural language.
Connect Claude, Cursor, Codex or any MCP client and it drives the whole platform.
Let your embedded users connect their automations to AI with one click
